# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility for rendering a safe HTML event invitation. The function `render_event_invitation` takes raw user input, escapes it to prevent cross‑site scripting (XSS) attacks, and injects the escaped values into a predefined invitation template. The output is a fully‑formed, well‑structured HTML string suitable for rendering in a browser. CWE-707 (Improper Neutralization of Structured Data) is mitigated by strictly escaping all user‑supplied content before it can be interpreted as HTML or JavaScript. No untrusted data is passed to `format` without escaping. """ from __future__ import annotations import html from typing import Final # Template for the invitation. The placeholders are intentionally simple # and will be replaced by escaped values. INVITATION_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}

Additional Notes

{additional_notes}
""" def render_event_invitation( event_title: str, event_description: str, event_date: str, additional_notes: str ) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML invitation. Parameters ---------- event_title : str Title of the event. event_description : str Full description (may contain line breaks). event_date : str Date of the event. additional_notes : str Any extra notes from the user. Returns ------- str A safe, well‑formed HTML string ready for rendering. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types early if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in ( event_title, event_description, event_date, additional_notes )): raise TypeError("All arguments must be of type str") # Escape all user inputs to neutralize any embedded markup or scripts. escaped_title = html.escape(event_title, quote=True) escaped_description = html.escape(event_description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") escaped_date = html.escape(event_date, quote=True) escaped_notes = html.escape(additional_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Format the invitation using the sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=escaped_title, event_description=escaped_description, event_date=escaped_date, additional_notes=escaped_notes ) return invitation_html.strip()
